Paper Name: Modeling downdraft biomass gasification process by restricting chemical reaction equilibrium with Aspen Plus
NOTES: Paper is about Aspen Plus modeling of downdraft biomass gasification process (syngas composition, LHV, H2/CO ratio) — not a hybrid renewable energy system. None of the energy system configuration, economic, O&M, replacement cost, or emission parameters are applicable. Only H2_LHV (11.2 MJ/Nm3) is explicitly reported as a standard chemical property used in LHV calculation (Eq. 3). Feedstock ultimate/proximate analysis of hardwood chips reported (Table 3) but these are not among the extraction template parameters. No load demand, LCOE, LPSP, or COE reported. No PV/WT/H2/FC/EL/DG components present.
